digest.component_or_area: graph link escalation / library & MCP interface
propositions: Cross-subtree blocking links are silently escalated to nearest common ancestor children for library and MCP callers, with no return value indicating the substitution occurred

add_dependency records a redirect to stdout via _emit_redirect, but this output is discarded by quiet=True sinks in the call chain, preventing library and MCP callers from learning what edge was actually recorded
Three intermediate layers (_link closure, _python_leaf, rebar.link) in the call chain drop the return value from add_dependency without propagating it to the caller
The MCP link_tickets tool returns literal 'ok' regardless of whether endpoint escalation occurred, providing no indication to agents that different endpoints were recorded than requested
quiet=True suppression cannot be removed because rebar-mcp uses MCP-over-stdio, and unsuppressed stdout would corrupt the JSON-RPC stream

The fix must return the redirect record as a value through all five propagation layers while leaving quiet=True intact, and report escalation in the MCP return string without changing the declared str return type
